text:
jess-support: customer signed up 30m ago, verified email, completed 3DS on card, got the onboarding success page but no free-trial credits landed. account: acct_9b2f, region detected as EU after email redirect. any quick checks?
ryan-payments: can you confirm payment method type? card BIN or virtual? sometimes virtual cards get flagged by BIN_DB rule.
jess-support: they used a virtual card via one-click checkout (vendor QuickCheckout). BIN looks like 489012 - appears EU issuer.
priya-ops: noted. I see an event in auth logs: `onboarding.autogrant_block` with reason `pm_bin_risk` around 1761112205. That'd block auto-grant.
dan-eng: is pm_bin_risk different from the usual bin_country_mismatch gate?
priya-ops: yes — bin_country_mismatch compares billing country vs detected geo. pm_bin_risk is our payments fraud scoring hitting threshold. In this case score=0.78 (threshold 0.7).
jess-support: customer says 3DS passed and they completed email verification. how do we proceed if the score is high but everything else looks fine?
ryan-payments: we can request manual review or a temporary manual grant. For manual grant run internal endpoint or use console flow. Dan, does the internal API accept {account, grant_type, admin_note}?
dan-eng: yep `POST /internal/v1/grants` with JSON body. quick snippet: ```curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/internal/v1/grants 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>' 
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
 -d '{"account_id":"acct_9b2f","amount_credits":200,"reason":"manual_review_passed:3ds+email","notes":"ops approved after phone check"}'```
priya-ops: before manual grant, can support verify 1) phone number on file, 2) small account usage pattern (no suspicious reuse), and 3) ask user to try signup without VPN? sometimes QuickCheckout shows EU redirect causing email-hosted redirect mismatch.
jess-support: asked user for phone and whether they were on VPN. user replied: "phone confirmed, not on VPN, but used GitHub SSO and then got bounced to eu.example.com during payment redirect."
ryan-payments: that redirect could cause region detection to flip mid-flow — our post-signup region check sees EU and applies stricter PM scoring. We can override if ops confirms manual checks.
priya-ops: I approved a manual review in the ops dashboard (review id rvw_88c). score override set to allow auto-grant.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout of ops/override-service v2.14 succeeded (deploy id d-7782)
jess-support: ran the internal grant per Dan's snippet (used admin token with limited scope). response: 200 OK, grant_id g-552, credits_added 200. user now sees credits in UI.
jess-support: customer confirmed credits appeared and they can hit the API now. :tada:
dan-eng: opened a small follow-up ticket to add a telemetry tag so we can catch these redirect-triggered region flips: TICKET-4891.
ryan-payments: also going to add a near-term rule tweak to exclude verified-3ds + verified-email combos from auto-block unless other signals present. will propose in payments triage.
priya-ops: notes for the support playbook: if `onboarding.autogrant_block` == `pm_bin_risk` and user completed 3DS + email verified + phone check, then escalate to ops for manual_review and consider manual grant. add links to internal grant snippet.
jess-support: closing thread — manual grant completed, user happy. tagging for docs update. :white_check_mark:
